corpus.labeling: Existing conversion manifest sourceFormat, otherwise fixture filename; aliases jpeg/jpg, tif/tiff, htm/html, stp/step, mpeg/mpg, bzip2/bz2, zstd/zst normalized. Labels are not an independent content audit.
limitations: Development corpus, not a held-out accuracy test. Includes generated and duplicate samples.
Original-name extension success is by construction against extension-derived labels, not successful rendering or validation.
Label disagreements need review; a filename may itself be wrong.
Container/family matches and generic text abstentions do not count as exact matches.
Renamed scenarios reuse the same bytes and predictions, not additional independent samples.
No MIME hints in routing scenarios; recognized incorrect extensions remain authoritative in extension-first policy.
Specific predictions indicate format evidence, not whole-file validation.
developmentReview: Initial XML-root rule classified ReadingCard.vue as XML. Added declaration/namespace requirement for generic XML; Vue now abstains. This corpus informed development.
sample.shtml/sample.xhtml/sample.xht/sample.xhtm contain HTML doctype/root without an XHTML namespace; HTML is a family match, not exact suffix recovery.
No declared 0-disagreement result should be read as a measured zero false-positive rate on independent data.

nativeTiming.scope: warm filesystem, whole batch including process startup and JSON output

wasmTiming.scope: Node V8 using frontend in-memory WASI host, one instance per file; input read excluded, input host setup included; one pass in corpus order
